data.tuwunel.toml:
[global]
server_name = "matrix.tom-mendy.com"
database_path = "/var/lib/tuwunel"
database_backup_path = "/var/lib/tuwunel-backups"
database_backups_to_keep = 3
admin_signal_execute = ["server backup-database"]
address = ["0.0.0.0"]
port = 8008
max_request_size = "100 MiB"
allow_federation = true
allow_registration = true
allow_guest_registration = false
login_with_password = false
allow_public_room_directory_over_federation = false
allow_public_room_directory_without_auth = false
ip_source = "rightmost_x_forwarded_for"
registration_token_file = "/run/secrets/registration-shared-secret"
registration_shared_secret_file = "/run/secrets/registration-shared-secret"

[[global.identity_provider]]
brand = "Authentik"
client_id = "matrix"
client_secret_file = "/run/secrets/oidc-client-secret"
issuer_url = "https://authentik.tom-mendy.com/application/o/matrix/"
callback_url = "https://matrix.tom-mendy.com/_matrix/client/unstable/login/sso/callback/matrix"
default = true
name = "Authentik"
trusted = false
registration = true
userid_claims = ["preferred_username"]
unique_id_fallbacks = false

[global.well_known]
client = "https://matrix.tom-mendy.com"
server = "matrix.tom-mendy.com:443"
livekit_url = "https://rtc.tom-mendy.com"
